testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/home-page/verify-header-components-and-quick-order.spec.ts > Webstore - Home Page > verify header components, navigation and quick order

scenario.summary: A registered user signs in from the header (submit button reads 'Sign In'), checks the header components (logo, search, Quick Order, Track Order, Departments, cart), searches a product SKU in the header search and sees a result, opens the Quick Order fly-out and types the SKU into row 0, checks the Track Order link text and opens the order lookup form, opens the Departments menu and reaches the cart page.
steps: Open Home as a guest; Sign In; type the account's username and password; submit button contains 'Sign In'; submit; greeting shown
Header components visible: logo, search input, Quick Order link, Track Order link, Departments, cart link
Header search for the product SKU; first search result visible
Logo -> Home; open the Quick Order fly-out; type the SKU into row 0; the field holds the SKU
Logo -> Home; Track Order link contains 'Track Order'; open the track-order form; order number input visible
Logo -> Home; Departments visible and clicked; open the cart page; cart heading or empty-cart message visible
stateChanges: Signs the account in (new session); nothing is added to the cart (the quick-order row is not submitted)
assertions: Sign-in submit button contains 'Sign In' (fixed UI text)
First header search result visible for the SKU
Quick Order row 0 input has the typed SKU
Track Order link contains 'Track Order' (fixed UI text); order number input visible
Cart heading or empty-cart message visible
evidence: Title 'verify header components, navigation and quick order' and the step labels match the flow; no linked cases, no AIO file.

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec opts out of the shared session (test.use storageState empty) and signs in with username/password from its own JSON (credential sources, masked). USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store} preferred.required true on the username source; the migrated test declares it with await testData.useExisting('user', data.username) before signing in (same pattern as the approved quick-order retail entries).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the webstore every migrated webstore spec runs on (testimEnv.web.baseUrl), same store as the approved quick-order/pdp entries.

sku z-1234579: profile FOUND, a BundleProduct ('DeWalt 3-Tool Combo Kit Bundle', inventory 28362, storefront index 1). Used for the header search (first result visible) and typed into Quick Order row 0 (value checked, not submitted). product = PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 1, maxPersonalizableAttributes 0 (Quick Order rejects personalizable products, as in the quick-order module), store}. The storefront index constraint (>= 1) keeps it searchable. No preferred: the recorded bundle does not qualify for a simple-product key. REVIEW: PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK with preferred z-1234579 would keep the recorded product, but Quick Order acceptance of a bundle SKU is not needed by this test and a simple product is the safer entry point.
The two literal '0' values are the Quick Order row index (config); profile NOT_FOUND for them as products is noise. '/' is the home path (config).
migrate: the JSON is read with a raw import and an 'as HeaderData' cast, not loadData (swap rule 1 fails); the account is declared with testData.useExisting.
